annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部办公厅关于做好2024年工业和信息化质量工作的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Doing a Good Job in Industrial and Information Technology Quality Work in 2024
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部办公厅 (General Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
annotation.summary_en: MIIT General Office notice setting 2024 tasks for manufacturing quality improvement, pilot-scale testing (zhongshi) development and "Made in China" brand building, including quality management capability assessment, reliability improvement, standards and laboratory management. It has no AI or robotics content beyond passing mention of civil drones.
key_provisions_or_claims: Implement Manufacturing Excellence Quality Project, with quality management capability evaluation of over 1,000 enterprises
Reliability improvement actions in machinery, electronics and automotive sectors
Promote policy implementation for civil unmanned aircraft quality and safety, among other key products
Build pilot-scale testing platforms and a pilot-testing standards system
Local authorities to provide funding and submit annual summaries by 10 December 2024
